metadata.derivation: Derived by SpektraLab from kodak_portra_400 (structure only): Fujifilm Neopan 100 Acros II datasheet: D-76 20 C 7 min curve; spectral sensitivity traced from the raster graph. Black-and-white profile with three identical channels: characteristic curve and spectral sensitivity digitized from the manufacturer datasheet (base+fog 0.05 removed, log exposure 0 at H = 8.1/ISO with ISO 100); spectrally flat silver density; hanatos2025 adaptation data are the base's.
